responsibility: Is the declarative table of overloaded rs6000 vector and intrinsic entry points. For each overloaded builtin name it lists the exported alias or ABI macro name, the internal overloaded function name, and the concrete builtin instance signatures they resolve to, providing rs6000-gen-builtins.cc and rs6000-c.cc with the data needed to generate overload metadata, vector-define aliases, and front-end resolution logic.
